tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The logo's black. Tab body in light mode, app-icon ground, one-colour ink print. Same in both themes; use `ink` or `surface` for UI.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The logo's off-white. Tab body in dark mode, light-mode page ground. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: The signal. The tab cap and the single accent point of a view. Never text or thin marks on `surface` in light mode (2.8:1); use `accent-text`. Ink text on it is 6.2:1; paper text on it fails (2.8:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Body copy `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs, menus sitting on `surface`. `ink`, `ink-muted`, `ink-subtle` all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks, table headers, wells. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it; `ink-subtle` reads at 5.0:1 (light) and 6.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, toasts, the footer band. Text on it is `on-inverse`.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `inverse`. 17:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. 15:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. 6.8:1 or better.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Captions, placeholders, units on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. 5.0:1 or better. Not for disabled controls (those are exempt and use 40% opacity).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: table rows, panel edges, dividers. Not a control border (use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons) and meaningful dividers. 3.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill for THE one call to action in a view, active-state cap, progress bars, the single highlighted datum. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for `accent`. `on-accent` stays 7.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for `accent`. `on-accent` stays 5.2:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`, `accent-hover`, `accent-press`. Always ink, never paper.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange used AS text, links or small icons on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`. 4.6:1 or better in both themes (light mode uses a deeper orange).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px `surface` gap. 3:1 or better on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken` in both themes (ink in light, orange in dark); the gap keeps it apart from `accent` fills.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Success. Blue on purpose: it never sits on the red-green axis. Always paired with a check glyph and the word. 5:1 or better as text.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Warning. Always paired with a triangle glyph and the word. 4.6:1 or better as text.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Error or destructive. Always paired with a cross glyph and the word. 4.7:1 or better as text; lighter than `status-ok` in dark mode and deeper in light, so the pair differs in lightness.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, and the one highlighted series. 3.8:1 or better as a mark on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Blue.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Teal-green.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Reddish purple.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Amber.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 and reference or baseline lines. Grey.

tokens.name: data-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis ticks. Quieter than any series; never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, lowest value (heatmaps, choropleths). Ramp runs light to deep in light mode and dark to bright in dark mode so higher always reads stronger.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, middle.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, highest value.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords and control flow on `surface-sunken`. 4.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and constants on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments on `surface-sunken`. 5.0:1 or better.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Code: function and variable names on `surface-sunken`; set in weight 500.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Code: types and classes on `surface-sunken`.

families.sans: "Space Grotesk", "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements, one per page. Pair a 300 word with a 700 word (`builtby` + `josef`).

styles.name: display-light
styles.usage: The light half of a light-bold pair. Never alone for body-size text.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page heading inside apps and docs.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Space is a material, not what is left over.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Set the unit once and keep it everywhere.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, table cells. Smallest size on screen.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and field labels, set UPPERCASE.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: code-s
styles.usage: Inline code in captions, log lines.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: Hero numbers in stats. Light weight, tabular figures, unit in `label`.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and stat rows. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: Eight-pixel grid with a four-pixel half step. The Tab itself is 72 x 128: 9 x 16 units of 8, a 9:16 ratio.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Half step. Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit. Related items, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact padding (small buttons, badges).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding and gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a panel or page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large breaks, page margins on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Ma: deliberate empty space around hero statements.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The height of one Tab. Largest step; page top padding on covers.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, checkbox corners, code-inline.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The Tab's own corner (10 on 72 wide). Buttons, inputs, panels. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large containers, modals, image frames.

tokens.name: radius-app
tokens.usage: App icons: 112 of 512 (re-export per platform).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, tags, progress track.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Depth comes from borders and the one hard offset shadow. Soft shadows only on floating menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover/raised state for panels and buttons: a hard, blurless offset like a stamp. Pair with translate(-2px,-2px).

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and toasts that float above the page. Nothing else.

size.note: Fixed dimensions taken from the logo and from touch targets.

tokens.name: tab-w
tokens.usage: Tab width at native scale (viewBox 72 x 128).

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: Tab height at native scale.

tokens.name: tab-cap
tokens.usage: Orange cap height at native scale (11% of tab height). Panels use `cap-h`.

tokens.name: cap-h
tokens.usage: Cap bar height on panels and primary buttons.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for prose.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on wide screens.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, panel edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on focus and outline buttons; matches the tab-outline stroke.

duration.note: Snap, then settle. Short for state, longer for place. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` all go to 0ms.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, checkbox ticks.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Cap sweep, panel lift, menus opening.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panels and drawers entering, number counters.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: Page-level transitions. The ceiling; nothing is slower.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default. Entrances and anything the user triggers: fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only, and at 60% of the entrance duration.

tokens.name: ease-inout
tokens.usage: Things moving between two places on screen (tab switch, reorder).

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: The only overshoot: toggles and the cap landing. Small elements only.
